subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of technique before load: sequencing a progression in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe joint range, control, and mobility work using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply core and postural control in real movement in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving progressive loading with bodyweight or available equipment; correct it and explain why.
Connect recognizing technique breakdown and stopping the set with programming strength and mobility into a wider plan and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Build a technique-first strength and mobility progression, document the criteria for advancing each movement, and show a completed progression with the criteria met.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Strength, Mobility, and Movement Quality?
